notes: Falconer Adept, printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 WHITE Bird creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking.' Your Feat of Resistance gives the Adept a +1/+1 counter and protection from blue (colour word 1 = U), so the opponent's blue flier Opp Hawk cannot block it. The opponent's Feat of Resistance gives Opp Hawk a +1/+1 counter and protection from white (word 0 = W). The Adept attacks; the Bird token enters tapped and attacking; the Hawk blocks the Bird (its only legal block; the step's spare word goes to its unmapped block ask). The white Bird's 1 damage to the Hawk is prevented (CR 702.16e), the 2/2 Hawk kills the Bird, the 3/4 Adept deals 3: opponent 20 -> 17, no damage marked anywhere. A non-white Bird would mark 1 on the Hawk.
